title: Ryan Davis
text: I am an Industrial Engineering & Operations Analytics student at the University of Arkansas. I am interested in supply chain, operations, and using data to improve processes and solve problems. Through my coursework I am developing skills in coding, statistics, data analysis, and much more. I look forward to continuing to develop my skills and applying what I learn to real-world engineering challenges in the future.
